trap-superlative.notes: STRUCTURAL FINDINGS (report only). (1) SIGN: 'Under the spectral coordinate mapping, alpha_i = q^{rho_i} -> e^{-rho_i log p} at each prime p'. e^{-rho log p} = p^{-rho}, so this substitutes q -> 1/p. The Lean sibling classical-riemann-zeta.lean states the convention explicitly - 'Each prime p contributes a local factor from the q-zeta function at q = p' - under which q^{rho_i} -> p^{+rho_i} = e^{+rho_i log p}. The block's own local zeta is written Z(B, q^{-s}) assembling into p^{-s}, i.e. q <-> p, agreeing with the Lean and not with the displayed minus sign. (2) The Lean's adelic_assembly is a bare 'Prop'-valued field (satisfiable by True), so the block's central claim - that the local q-zetas assemble into zeta - has no formal content behind it; same AGENTS.md 3b-tax proof-claims-unencoded pattern as is_exact in classical-limit-functor.lean. (3) Minor: 'The non-trivial zeros of zeta(s) are the classical shadows of the Reeb eigenvalues' is an interpretive claim inside a definition block (definition-clarity clarity-stmt-pure); it belongs in a follow-on remark. (4) Minor: 'Each maximal ideal m of norm N(m) = p^f' - over Q, f = 1 always, so the residue-degree generality is unused here.
